findings_review.heatmap_numbers: PDF text spans combine discontiguous cells and rows, producing oversized span boxes. All 60 labels were independently reconstructed from individual PDF glyphs, match the measured values and have at least 2.37 pt inset within their own cells.
findings_review.heatmap_ticks: The source text nodes and their positions are unchanged from the original author-edited 5-by-6 asset; individual tick labels are visually separate.
findings_review.histogram_annotation: Two manually positioned lines inside each original rounded annotation box were reviewed in the complete figure and page24; no visible overlap.
findings_review.scatter_axes: Negative ticks and rotated axis title, and ticks20/30 versus the horizontal title, were reviewed in dedicated full-resolution crops. The visible glyphs are separate. Original typefaces and sizes are retained.
